description:
A secret and lustful Joseon era fantasy BL that takes place around a beautiful secret heaven!

“You, a lowly, try to drown me, a human, and send me to hell… .”

A being who flew through the sky in the past to take care of humans, Bicheon!  
Now, all of them have disappeared and the bichon, which was thought to be only a legend, has been put up at the auction house.  
Also for the 'collection of dolls', the secret and lustful hobby of gents!  
The yangbans compete fiercely to turn the beautiful Bicheon into their 'doll'.  
Whose hand will the abyss fall into?  
A fierce and beautiful story that takes place around a beautiful rain stream begins.

[Original Webtoon](https://ridibooks.com/books/297020146)
